Codex Whip 1.9.0
A cleaner menu, a clearer Activity window and the new film.
• The menu drops its name row, spells out intervals such as Retry Every 3 Minutes and ends with Quit Codex Whip. • Activity shows times such as Today at 6:38 AM, session ID endings and clear headings, and refreshes while it is open. • Copy, paste, undo and Command-W now work in the retry message editor and the app’s windows. • Approve Start at Login… opens System Settings instead of turning the option off. • When something goes wrong, the menu says so plainly: Stopped unexpectedly, Couldn’t start or Codex isn’t open. • The update notice names the new version. • Watch Demo plays the new film, which ends on codexwhip.com.
Your retry settings, session state, history, app identity and update-verification key are preserved.
macOS 14 or later. This community build is ad hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
